summary: Russia launched coordinated missile and drone strikes across multiple Ukrainian regions including Kyiv, with Geran-5 missiles, Shahed drones, and an FP-7 ballistic missile. Ukraine struck Russian naval and infrastructure targets in Orlovskaya, Samara, and Bryansk oblasts. A Ukrainian MiG-29 pilot was killed in combat.
key_points: Russia attacked Kyiv's Southern Bridge twice and a school; drone strike hit nuclear research institute, no casualties reported (Source: @UkraineNow/84430).
Ukrainian pilot Marat Mambetov, commander of flight section 40th Tactical Aviation Brigade, killed in MiG-29 during combat mission (Source: @UkraineNow/84422).
Geran-5 missile launched from Zhytomyr toward Rivne; Shahed drones from Cherkasy toward Kyiv and Poltava toward Kirovohrad (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76021).
Ukraine struck Russian ship in Black Sea and targets in Orlovskaya, Samara, Bryansk oblasts including drone launch sites (Source: @UkraineNow/84414).
Drones detected over Poltava, Chernihiv near Novhorod-Siverskyi and Nizhyn, Cherkasy toward Kaniv, Dnipropetrovsk toward Pavlohrad (Source: @kpszsu).
Data center Parkovyi critically damaged by Russian strikes, fully ceased operations (Source: @UkraineNow/84418).
Russia plans attack on Lutsk with Geran-5 missiles and Geran-4 drones within the week (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76016).

sections.executive_summary: Russia launched coordinated missile and drone strikes across multiple Ukrainian regions including Kyiv, with Geran-5 missiles, Shahed drones, and an FP-7 ballistic missile. Ukraine struck Russian naval and infrastructure targets in Orlovskaya, Samara, and Bryansk oblasts. A Ukrainian MiG-29 pilot was killed in combat.

key_developments: Russia launched Geran-5 missile from Zhytomyr toward Rivne alongside Shahed drones from Cherkasy toward Kyiv and Poltava toward Kirovohrad in coordinated strikes (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76021).
Ukrainian pilot Marat Mambetov, flight section commander of 40th Tactical Aviation Brigade, killed when MiG-29 was shot down by enemy missile during combat mission (Source: @UkraineNow/84422).
Russia attacked Kyiv Southern Bridge twice and a school; drone strike hit nuclear research institute in Kyiv, reactor safe, no casualties (Source: @UkraineNow/84430, @UkraineNow/84417).
Ukraine struck Russian ship in Black Sea and targets in Orlovskaya, Samara, and Bryansk oblasts including drone launch sites and oil facility (Source: @UkraineNow/84414).

Reconnaissance drones detected across multiple regions: Poltava, Chernihiv near Novhorod-Siverskyi and Nizhyn, Cherkasy toward Kaniv, Dnipropetrovsk toward Pavlohrad, Zhytomyr from Chernobyl zone (Source: @kpszsu).
Russia plans attack on Lutsk with Geran-5 missiles and Geran-4 reconnaissance-strike drones within the week (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76016).
Data center Parkovyi critically damaged by Russian strikes, fully ceased operations; Nova Poshta services disrupted by DDoS attack (Source: @UkraineNow/84418, @UkraineNow/84421).
sections.threat_assessment: Russia is conducting multi-axis drone and missile operations simultaneously targeting Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Rivne, Kirovohrad, and Dnipropetrovsk regions with Geran-5 missiles and Shahed drones. The planned attack on Lutsk with Geran-5 and Geran-4 systems within the week indicates expanding operational reach. Ukrainian air defense faces sustained pressure from volumetric drone attacks originating from multiple directions including the Chernobyl exclusion zone and Black Sea. The strike on a nuclear research institute in Kyiv, while causing no casualties, represents a dangerous escalation in targeting sensitivity.
sections.regional_response: Ukraine's GUR MOU has publicly appealed for drone parts collection, specifically fiber optic cable, indicating supply chain strain on the front line. Ukrainian forces struck Russian targets in Orlovskaya, Samara, and Bryansk oblasts, demonstrating continued deep-strike capability. Zelensky's visit to the Lyman direction and display of FP-7 ballistic missile combat use signal continued offensive operations. The destruction of the Parkovyi data center and DDoS attacks on Nova Poshta suggest Russian hybrid warfare targeting civilian infrastructure and logistics.
sections.intelligence_notes: The simultaneous launch of Geran-5 missiles and Shahed drones from multiple oblasts suggests coordinated Russian operational planning. The loss of a MiG-29 with call sign details indicates Russian air defense improvements. Drone traffic through the Chernobyl exclusion zone toward Zhytomyr represents a novel infiltration route requiring monitoring. The Volgograd apartment fire from drone attack and Voronezh helicopter loss confirm Russian territory vulnerability. The GUR MOU drone parts request suggests quality and quantity shortages in state-provided unmanned systems.
